snippet.title: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 2.5.2026
snippet.description:
CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS is coming to Nintendo Switch in 2026.

22 national teams. Over 110 playable characters. 1 game: soccer.

Experience super soccer action in Captain Tsubasa’s latest installment, where a continuous stream of spectacular plays creates unpredictable match sequences!

#CAPTAINTSUBASA2 #NintendoDirect #NintendoSwitch
